# NeuralFidelityMetric

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A composite metric that quantifies the degree of match between simulated spiking activity and recorded biological neuron responses. Provides a standardized measure for evaluating neuromorphic hardware, enabling objective comparisons across different architectures.
